title: Document publication process and version tagging convention

version_convention.tagging_rule: Publish only an immutable public version from the approved source commit; never reuse a name/version for different bytes.

required_identity: uv.lock SHA-256 and selected runtime subset
process: Build and qualify once from the approved immutable revision.
Publish the exact qualified wheel without rebuilding.
Reject a pre-existing coordinate if its digest differs.
Download by exact version into an empty clean environment.
Compare SHA-256 to the qualified wheel.
Re-run the installed-wheel matrix and retain redacted evidence before rollout.
prohibited: consumer rollout after upload acknowledgement alone
finding: Process and tagging convention are recorded; actual publication remains pending the registry decision and operator approval.
